title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1982-09-18
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> SoundDevices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v8.0 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: A solid audience recording that captures a memorable 1982 show despite the venue’s acoustic challenges.
ai_review.review: The tape, recorded from the audience, is praised for being clearer than most given how tough the hall was to hear in. Fans remember the concert fondly – it wasn’t the band’s peak performance, but it was an exciting first Dead experience for several listeners. Overall the show and its capture are considered good enough to recommend.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently positive remarks about both the recording (good despite venue) and the concert (memorable, enjoyable), with only a single modest 3‑star comment on show strength.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough given a notoriously difficult acoustic environment; captures the performance well though not pristine, and is considered an improvement over other available sources.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers focus on overall enjoyment rather than song‑by‑song analysis.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted for briefly announcing a short break, but no specific playing remarks.
